title: Livin It Up Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Located in Old Seagrove, Livin It Up is a beautifully renovated 3 bedroom/ 2 bath home that sleeps 8 comfortably with private heated pool!
description_expanded: Located on 1st street outside of Seaside, 1 ½ blocks to the beach Great location for walking and biking to the beach, restaurants, shops and grocery 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms Sleeps 8 Hardwood floors throughout (except bathrooms) Free WiFi and Smart TVs with streaming capability Private, heated pool (heating is optional and pool heating fees apply) Original artwork Books and games Central air/heat Yard: Beautiful canopy of live oaks Front sidewalk leading to covered front porch Parking spaces for 3 cars – graveled Fenced backyard with 6-foot privacy fence Heated private pool (additional fee for heating applies) Large pool deck with 2 dining tables, gas grill, chaises and chairs Landscaped backyard Outdoor shower Front Porch: Covered Porch swing Small table with 2 chairs 1st Level: Living Area 55 inch Smart TV, Blue-Ray player Comfortably furnished with ample seating Ceiling fan Accents of reclaimed cypress from the Choctawhatchee River and shiplap wood walls Opens to dining area and kitchen Dining: Custom made reclaimed wood dining table with seating for 6 people Additional seating at counter with 3 bar stools Kitchen: Quartzite counter tops Custom cabinetry Reclaimed wood barn door Reclaimed wood shelves Stainless appliances (Refrigerator, glass top range, oven, dishwasher, microwave) Toaster, coffee maker, blender, cookware, bake ware, dishes & utensils Hall Bathroom: Custom vanity with marble top Shiplap wood wall accents Ceramic tile with glass tile accents Large walk-in shower with glass shower doors (shower only) Downstairs Bedroom with above Hall Bath: Queen bed Shiplap wood wall accents 40 inch Smart TV Ceiling fan Walk in closet Overlooks pool (with access to backyard pool area) Laundry Room: Full size washer and dryer Additional cabinet and shelf space Access to backyard 2nd Level: Master Bedroom King bed Spacious room with vaulted ceiling Ceiling fan 50 inch Smart TV 2 closets Access to screened porch Screened porch (2nd level): 2 comfortable cushioned chairs, an ottoman and a side table Vaulted ceiling and ceiling fan Bedroom 3: Queen bed, built-in twin bunk bed Shiplap wood wall accents 30 inch Smart TV Ceiling fan Bathroom (shared between master bedroom and bedroom 3): Custom vanity with Carrara marble top Deep soaking tub/shower combo Marble floor Ceramic tile tub surround with marble accents 3rd Level: Reading Nook Built in seating Custom light fixture 4th Level: Tower Views of rooftops and ocean Ceiling fan Seating for 2 Wine refrigerator Small outside deck with additional seating for 2 ***Pool heat is an additional $300- Please contact Sandpiper Vacation to add this to your reservation if you would like the pool heated during your stay -Vacation Cancellation Protection- Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($125 fee applies at booking) **2 Complimentary bikes to use during your stay!** ** Town pictures are of Seaside and Rosemary Beach. FREE WiFi

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
